additional_info.subject: RE: ID0396348-DC/Si-D/UA-[MP / R9 170002580] Termination of  charging session CRM:01811000522
additional_info.body:
Dear eMobility Tech Support Team,
Our customer has some issues related to the ticket
number 0396348
. On December 14th and 15th the  charger was transmitted to the OCPP invalid Meter Values regarding some sessions on CHAdeMO port (DC1). Because of this, some
clients
received bills for the consumption during sessions (up to 100 kW) which didn't exist. This means that after the session ended, the charging station continued to send Meter Values as if the session had been going on for a long period.
In order to understand this situation and find which values ​​were wrong, the Customer yesterday asked to send log files for December 14th and 15
th
.
I tried to download logs for these dates and noticed that some time periods were missing, and some were recorded at the wrong time.
Also, I was not able to fully identify all the missing intervals because I was not able to download all logs.
Therefore, I kindly ask you for the following:
Please provide log files for December
14th and 15
th
Could you please clarify what is the source of the timestamp data for the charging station? If this data comes from the GSM provider, is it possible to change it somehow? (Due to the operation of electronic warfare equipment, false data may be received from the GSM provider).
Check sessions on the
CHAdeMO port (DC1)
for December 14th and 15th in order to help the Customer find false
Meter Values.
Inform about the reasons for this failure and how to fix it in the future.
Thank you!
With best regards,
Ievgen Tokhtamyshev

04071 Kyiv, Ukraine

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0396348-DC/Si-D/UA-[MP / R9 170002580] Termination of  charging session CRM:01811000522
additional_info.body:
Hello Ievgen,
Sorry for my late reply here. I took a look on the logs and what I have noticed is that we were sending the Finishing state via OCPP but we were never sending a change of outlet status. Look for example the comparison between logs from last days and logs from that day.
On that day event:
And this finishing state goes until next day. I'm not entirely sure if this was a issue on ecog KF11 or already some bug because of the faulty cable.
But we don't have any report of this happening again and this is related to the old FW version. Please if you find another similar case report to us in new ticket.
Any additional information regarding this topic feel free to reach out to me via TEAMS, since no other activity is needed in this case I will proceed to close this ticket.
Thank you.
With best regards,
